surface_name: Workers CPU time limit, Free plan
title: Worker on the Free plan fails with Error 1102 'Worker exceeded resource limits' under normal load
symptoms: Requests that parse large JSON, hash passwords, or render HTML fail intermittently
The same code passes in wrangler dev
cause: Workers Free allows 10 ms of CPU time per HTTP request, while Paid defaults to 30 seconds and can be raised to 5 minutes. Waiting on fetch does not count, but parsing, crypto, and rendering do, and local dev does not enforce the cap.
fix: Move the Worker to Workers Paid and set a CPU limit, or move heavy work out of the request path.
affected: Cloudflare Workers Free plan, as of October 2026
